title: Russo-Ukrainian war
summary: Russia occupied and annexed Crimea in March 2014 and then armed and directed a separatist war in the Donbas that ran for eight years, killing some fourteen thousand people and settling into a front line that two agreements signed at Minsk failed to move. Ukraine declared the region occupied in 2018. The war's second phase opened with the full-scale invasion of February 2022 and it continues. The record covers the whole of it from 2014; the invasion has a record of its own, because what changed in 2022 was not the war's existence but its scale.
